exposure: maternal problems (premature rupture of membranes, placenta previa, ablatio placenta, preeclampsia, cholestasis of pregnancy, oligohydramnios, gestational diabetes mellitus)
cohort: A total of 230 late preterm neonates, born between 34 0/7 and 36 6/7 gestational weeks, who were followed in a Neonatal Intensive Care Unit.
finding: The study found that maternal problems and cholestasis of pregnancy were significantly more likely in neonates born at 34 0/7 and 34 6/7 gestational weeks, and late preterm neonates demonstrated high rates of respiratory, metabolic, and feeding morbidities during their NICU stay.
